name: Shoucheng Holdings Limited
summary: Shoucheng Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the infrastructure asset management business. It also offers private fund, asset management services; management services; equity investment; and operates carparks, as well as provides equity investments. The company was formerly known as Shougang Concord International Enterprises Company Limited and changed its name to Shoucheng Holdings Limited in May 2020. Shoucheng Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in North Point, Hong Kong.
